image_description: A close-up, low-angle view of a pipe organ installed against a textured stone wall. The image features a dense array of vertical metallic pipes of varying diameters and heights, arranged in a stepped silhouette. A prominent red-painted wooden structural element with decorative cutouts supports a cluster of larger pipes on the left. The lower section shows rows of smaller, tightly packed silver pipes. In the foreground, the top edge of a polished wooden console or casing is visible.
